newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian bourse index soars to new record.
newsitem.headline: Estonian bourse index soars to new record.

text.p: Estonia's bourse index crossed the 300 boundary for the first time on Wednesday as buying interest in Hansapank and Forekspank kept shares on an upward roll.
"There are lots of buyers and not many sellers about and the prices of most stocks were forced higher," one trader said.
"But we do expect a correction, especially in Hansa and Hoiupank, but we can't say when it will happen," he added.
Total trade on the main list was 53.8 million kroons with the Talse index 1.53 percent higher at 302.29.
Most dealers have been expecting a correction for the last three days and say it is too hard to pick the bourse's direction.
Hansapank led the main list, rising by 2.1 kroons to close at 168.50 kroons on trade of 19.2 million kroons.
Hansapank in Helsinki also reached a new high, closing up 1.1 markka at 63.10 markka on volume of 2.1 million markka.
"The buying interest in Hansa is holding, while in Helsinki the bid/ask was 63.10/64.00, so tomorrow will depend on what dealers have on their books to start the day," a dealer said.
Forekspank released a revised profit forecast for 1997 of 96.4 million kroons. It closed up 2.75 kroons up at 201.10 on trade of 12 million kroons.
"Forekspank is still a cheap stock on the bourse, so it is hard to say how far it could go," one trader said.
On the free market, privatisation securities dominated with 48.1 million kroons traded. They again closed higher on 0.43 kroons compared to 0.385 kroons on Tuesday.
"There are no sellers at all and the price just keeps on rising," one trader said.
Demand has been high for the compensation vouchers as investors anticipate the sale of stakes in Eesti Gaas and Hotel Olympia for vouchers.
